an5.1:0.1: suttantapiṭake aṅguttaranikāyassa tatiyo bhāgo pañcakanipāto namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa. paṭhamapaṇṇāsako
an5.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
